title: StockResearchRequest
description: Input payload for triggering an automated stock research and 6-slide report generation.

company_name.description: Full legal or commercial name of the company

exchange.description: Stock exchange where equity is traded

investor_profile.description: Target investor horizon and risk appetite

notification_phone.description: E.164 formatted phone number for voice milestone calls

enabled_milestones.description: List of milestones that should trigger an outbound phone call
